comment_data.body:
Thanks for the screencast!

I am afraid, the answer here is the same as #2118: I think it is because there was [deviation from the expected snippet session lifecycle](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/issues/2118#issuecomment-3547685131). Without exact steps for me to reproduce this *when following snippet session lifecycle*, there isn't much to do here. I'll take another look at the code, but there probably won't be anything new.

By the way, any reason why you didn't post it in #2118 directly? I'd expect it to be posted there, as the issue was closed until there is something new to add to the discussion.
